title: Anchor Engram doctor assurance parsing to the policy record
outcome: The doctor parser accepts the first required= token anywhere in stdout or stderr. Unrelated diagnostics can shadow the actual control-policy assurance and cause an incorrect enable/deny result.
acceptance: Only the intended control-policy assurance record is parsed; unrelated required= text is ignored; Advisory, TurnGated, ActionGated, missing, and conflicting-output cases are covered.
